fresh_full_matrix_corner_quadrature_and_.limitations: Reassembled scikit-fem stiffness, consistent mass, inertia relief and full field reconstruction extend the existing fixed-boundary/traction archive audit; no new linear solve or changed physical problem is introduced. Original36-probe changes and unaveraged global peaks remain unchanged. Quadrature stresses are compared with the complete saved affine corner field. Original force samples are retained rather than replaced by a new load law. This closes a numerical evidence scope gap, not the unresolved physical tensor tail, spatial/contact/geometry/model/feedback acceptance or verified warmed native cost.

limitations: All25 original2/3/4/5/6-layer FEM fields keep fixed actual boundaries, mass, original tractions and36 probes. Fresh independent stiffness/mass/inertia-relief assembly rechecks every original complete force budget, full corner/quadrature tensors, energy, probes and unsmoothed global maxima. The original archive comparator's producer-recorded residual scope remains explicit rather than being mislabeled as fresh matrix reassembly. The15 older fields' immutable parent archive is fully reverified and referenced, not duplicated; every referenced actual parent input is rehashed. Tensor changes remain unresolved despite stable peak/energy. This is not three-dimensional bulk/CAD/contact/model/feedback or warmed physical accuracy/cost acceptance. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
